nodes.label: Mac Photos Sync

nodes.label: iOS Upload Part Store
nodes.rationale: Durable upload bytes are bounded and rehashed on reuse, with exact grant cleanup.

nodes.label: iOS Whole-File Upload Handoff
nodes.rationale: Retained parts verify the multipart composite before attachment completion, while shared history remains in Timeline.

nodes.label: iOS Continued-Upload Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Scheduler refusal falls back to foreground; background completion and relaunch acceptance remain open.

nodes.label: Android Current-File Upload Continuation
nodes.rationale: The OS lease is nonpersistent and token-scoped, and completed replies wait for foreground account validation.

nodes.label: Cloud Backup Source Retention
nodes.rationale: Only a verified completion seal proves independent bytes; a prepared inventory alone does not constitute a hold.

nodes.label: Upload Order Preferences
nodes.rationale: Device-local scheduling hints do not grant API access or deletion permission.

nodes.label: Device Sync and File Locations
nodes.rationale: Unfiled blobs have no recorded original folder location; names and MIME types never establish a path.

nodes.label: Device Activity Ownership
nodes.rationale: The activity manager tracks registered owners and does not claim to instrument arbitrary listeners or all operating-system processes.
